decisions.reason: As a core distributed control and monitoring solution that sets industry standards, it remains central to the firm's integrated airfield offering and has high option value.
The air situation display supports surveillance and tower solutions and remains relevant to the firm's integrated operations, so it is worth keeping while uncertainty is low.
The airport systems training program complements the firm's service portfolio and has low keeping costs, so the option remains open while demand is still uncertain.
The specific airfield ground lighting training course overlaps with the broader systems training program and shows limited strategic value, making its option less attractive.
The airport collaboration software tool aligns with the firm's move toward integrated intelligent airport operations and is worth keeping to resolve market acceptance.
The multilateration aircraft surveillance system is the flagship of the firm's strategic direction and has high option value, so it should be kept.
